subject: general
question: If two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, then which of the options below is necessarily true?

options.text: The sum of the measures of a pair of alternate interior angles is 180°
The sum of the measures of a pair of corresponding angles is 180°
The sum of the measures of a pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal is 180°
The sum of the measures of a pair of vertically opposite angles is 180°

solution:
**Given:**

Two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal.

**Concept Used:**

When two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, several angle relationships are formed, such as alternate interior angles, corresponding angles, and interior angles on the same side of the transversal.

**Calculation:**

1. Alternate interior angles are equal.

2. Corresponding angles are equal.

3. Interior angles on the same side of the transversal are supplementary (sum to 180º).

⇒ The sum of the measures of a pair of alternate interior angles is not necessarily 180º.

⇒ The sum of the measures of a pair of corresponding angles is not necessarily 180º.

⇒ The sum of the measures of a pair of vertically opposite angles is not necessarily 180º.

⇒ The sum of the measures of a pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal is necessarily 180º.

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Calculation:

If two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, then which of the options below is necessarily true?

1) The sum of the measures of a pair of alternate interior angles is 180°

2) The sum of the measures of a pair of corresponding angles is 180°

3) The sum of the measures of a pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal is 180°

4) The sum of the measures of a pair of vertically opposite angles is 180°

Explanation:

When two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal:

Alternate interior angles are equal.

Corresponding angles are equal.

The sum of the measures of a pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal is always 180°.

Vertically opposite angles are equal (this holds for any two intersecting lines).

**∴ The correct answer is 3) The sum of the measures of a pair of interior angles on the same side of the transversal is 180°.**
